resume_brief: WAVE 7C — ASHLANE WEAPONS + CREATURES. Hunt open-source 3D packs for AshLane (Urban Reign-style urban brawler, Halloween/seasonal creature roster). TARGETS: (1) WEAPONS (street): baseball bats, chains, pipes, bottles, 2x4s, kendo sticks, crowbars, trash-can lids — wieldable low-poly GLBs. (2) CREATURES: zombies, demons, spiders, bats, ghosts, skeletons, witches, vampires, pumpkin-headed fighters — animated where possible (min idle/walk/attack). Quaternius CC0 creature packs not already staged (already staged: quaternius-monsters, quaternius-ultimate-monsters, quaternius-spider, quaternius-witch, quaternius-rpg-characters, quaternius-animated-animals, quaternius-humanoids, quaternius-animated-characters, kaykit-halloween-bits, kaykit-skeletons). LICENSE LAW: CC0 or CC-BY ONLY. Verify license from source page/repo LICENSE for EVERY pack. NO GPL/AGPL, NO Mixamo/Adobe, NO non-commercial, NO no-derivatives. CC-BY needs author + source URL in credits manifest. SOURCES: Quaternius (CC0), Poly Pizza (per-model license field; direct https://static.poly.pizza/<uuid>.glb), OpenGameArt (CC0/CC-BY 3D art), itch.io CC0 packs, GitHub CC0 repos, Kenney (CC0; retry with backoff if rate-limited). Sketchfab: CANNOT download — build BROWSER-PULL LIST (name, author, license, exact URL) as BROWSER_PULL.md in pack dir. STAGE: ~/workspace/street-brawl-cicd/game/assets/staging/parts/w7c-ashlane-weapons-creatures/for-ashlane/ — one subdir per source pack + LICENSE.md per source pack (author, source URL, license). game/assets/staging/parts/ is git-ignored — do NOT git commit; just stage files. Write PACK_README.md in w7c-ashlane-weapons-creatures/ with pack list, model counts per category, animation-clip notes, licenses, gap log. DELIVERABLE: final message with pack list + counts + licenses + gap log + browser-pull list contents.
